title: Approve: build-claude-code-native-mail-hook also adds the read-only mail probe
problem: The Claude Code native-mail hook Action needs a cheap read-only existence probe that runs on every hook firing, but no such command exists: native-mail inbox writes receipts and native-mail status needs a message id. The submitted proposal proposal-native-mail-readonly-existence-probe-20261017 recorded this gap.
desired_effect: Accept Agent Ask amend-claude-hook-readonly-probe-20261017 and replace only criterion 2 of build-claude-code-native-mail-hook, so that Action first adds the read-only probe (ALLOWED in the experiment guard, writes nothing, tested). The other four criteria, title, status, dependencies and Plan pointers stay unchanged.

planUnchanged.milestone: Enable bounded local native Release Manager coordination with durable addressed messages, explicit checkpoint roundtrip proof, and explicit generation-fenced manager handoff.

actionBefore.title: Ship an opt-in, default-off Claude Code SessionStart+PostToolUse hook pair that surfaces new native-mail for the current session via one shared, two-tier checkpoint script.
actionBefore.next_action: Ship an opt-in, default-off Claude Code SessionStart+PostToolUse hook pair that surfaces new native-mail for the current session via one shared, two-tier checkpoint script.
acceptance_criteria: A SessionStart hook and a PostToolUse hook both run the same shared script; native-rm-checkpoint-roundtrip's own Claude Code measurement is re-verified against this exact built hook, not merely cited.

The script is two-tier: a cheap non-mutating existence probe runs every time; the real unacknowledged-only inbox read (which marks exposure and writes a receipt) runs only when the probe finds at least one live message, debounced to at most once per a fixed short interval.
Only unacknowledged, undisposed, unexpired mail is surfaced; already-acknowledged mail already filtered client-side never reappears.
The hook ships opt-in and default off; enabling it requires an explicit settings.json change, never a silent default or automatic activation.

Mail body text is rendered only as a quoted string for a human or agent to read; the hook never executes, shells out to, or interpolates mail body content. An adversarial test proves a forged-command-looking body still executes nothing.
